title: Krishna Ashtakam
intro: Krishna Ashtakam is a popular hymn describing the divine childhood and enchanting pastimes of Lord Krishna.
description:
Vasudeva Sutam Devam Kamsa Chanura Mardanam |
Devaki Paramanandam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Atasi Pushpa Sankasham Hara Nupura Shobhitam |
Ratna Kankana Keyuram Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Kutilalaka Sanyuktam Purnachandra Nibhananam |
Vilasat Kundaladharam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Mandara Gandha Sanyuktam Charuhasam Chaturbhujam |
Barhi Pichhava Chudangam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Utphulla Padma-patraksham Nila Jimuta Sannibham |
Yadvanam Shiroratnam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Rukmini Keli Sanyuktam Pitambara Sushobhitam |
Avapta Tulasi Gandham Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Gopikanana Kuchadvanda Kunkumankita Vakshasam |
Shriniketam Maheshvasam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Shrivatsankam Mahoraskam Vanamala Virajitam |
Shankha-chakra Dharam Devam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum ||

Krishnashtakam Idam Punyam Pratarutthayah Yah Pathet |
Koti-janma Kritam Papam Smaranena Vinashyati ||

faq.a1: This revered stotram was composed by the great philosopher Adi Shankaracharya, beautifully describing the divine form, attributes, and pastimes of Lord Krishna.
faq.q2: What are the benefits of reciting Krishnashtakam?
faq.a2: According to the final verse of the stotram, anyone who wakes up early in the morning and recites or remembers this pure Krishnashtakam has the sins of millions of births destroyed, attaining the supreme grace of Lord Krishna.
faq.q3: What is the central refrain of Krishnashtakam?
faq.a3: Each verse of this Ashtakam concludes with the powerful line "Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum", which means "I bow to Lord Krishna, the preceptor/teacher of the entire universe."
faq.q4: When is the best time to recite Krishnashtakam?
faq.a4: As stated in the text itself—"Pratarutthayah yah pathet"—it is best recited early in the morning right after waking up.
